title: Arma 3 SQF Reloader project settings
description: Project settings for .vscode/sqfReloader-settings.json. Missing keys use the extension defaults.

enabled.description: Send SQF changes to Arma 3 when a file is saved.

armaDirectory.description: Arma 3 installation folder (contains arma3_x64.exe). Leave empty to auto-detect from the registry / Steam libraries.

armaProfile.description: Arma 3 profile name to use for mission links and launch. Leave empty to use the most recently updated profile.

apiUrl.description: Host address of the SqfReloader REST API. The extension appends the API path and uses apiPort.

apiPort.description: Port used for API requests by every Arma instance (client, editor, hosted mission and dedicated server).

requestTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a request to Arma.

runTimeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for Run in Arma to return an SQF result.

autoJunction.description: Create a junction from the Arma 3 folder to the open mod folder automatically.

junctionMode.description: addon links each source addon below z\<tag>\addons; module links the whole @Mod folder.

reloadOnSave.description: How a saved SQF file is pushed to Arma.

deletedFunctionBehavior.description: Whether to clear a deleted fn_*.sqf function's missionNamespace variable from the running Arma instance.

notifyOnError.description: Show a notification when Arma is not reachable or a reload fails.

serverLaunchArguments.description: Additional startup arguments applied only to dedicated-server launches.

createExampleWithMission.description: Create example mod also writes a minimal test mission.

clearArmaMissionArtifacts.description: Automatically remove Arma-generated ~Mission.World preview folders from the active profile.

watchInterval.description: How often the project debug console reevaluates watch expressions, in milliseconds.

watchExpressions.description: SQF expressions saved as project debug-console watches.

commands.description: Commands run for this event. ${workspaceFolder}, ${armaDirectory}, ${missionFolder}, ${file}, ${apiUrl} and ${exitCode} are expanded.

blocking.description: Whether the caller waits for the commands before continuing.

continueOnError.description: Keep going when a command exits with a non-zero code.

hooks.description: Commands keyed by lifecycle event. Events: preClientLaunch, postClientLaunch, onClientConnected, preClientStop, postClientStop, onClientExit, preServerLaunch, postServerLaunch, onServerConnected, preServerStop, postServerStop, onServerCrash, preReload, postReload, onReloadError, preReloadAll, postReloadAll, postMissionRestart, preSetup, postSetup, preJunction, postJunctionCleanup, postScaffold, onModConfigChanged, onSettingsChanged, preMissionLink, postMissionLink, preHostMission, postHostMission.

hookPresentation.description: Default VS Code task presentation options for every hook terminal.

modTypes.description: Mod launch roles keyed by the mod folder path relative to the workspace folder.

externalMods.description: Additional local or Steam Workshop mod folders for this project.

echo.description: Echo the command in the terminal.

reveal.description: When the hook terminal is revealed.

focus.description: Move keyboard focus to the hook terminal.

panel.description: Whether the hook terminal reuses a shared panel, a dedicated one, or a new panel per run.
